data.title: Sick pay (Krankengeld) rejection from Muster BKK
data.summary: Muster BKK informs David Muster that his sick pay (Krankengeld) claim from 12 January 2026 is rejected because his incapacity for work was not reported within one week (§ 49 Abs. 1 Nr. 5 SGB V); sick pay will instead only be paid from 22 January 2026, the date the certificate was received.
data.explanation: Your health insurer says your right to sick pay does not apply for the period before 22 January 2026, because the medical certificate reached them too late. If you disagree, you can object (Widerspruch) in writing or in person at Muster BKK; the app will show the deadline for this objection. If you do nothing by then, the rejection becomes final. Consider seeking advice from the insurer or a social law advisor if you disagree.

key_facts.label: Legal basis for rejection
key_facts.quote: Ihr Anspruch auf Krankengeld ruht, weil die Arbeitsunfähigkeit nicht innerhalb einer Woche gemeldet wurde (§ 49 Abs. 1 Nr. 5 SGB V).

remedy.form_text: schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der Muster BKK
remedy.quote: Widerspruch gegen diesen Bescheid kann innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der Muster BKK erhoben werden.

items.title: Object to the sick pay rejection (Widerspruch)
items.action: If you disagree with the decision, submit a written objection (Widerspruch) to Muster BKK, or have it recorded in person there, by the deadline shown.
items.consequence: If you miss the deadline, the rejection becomes final and you lose the right to challenge it.
items.quote: Widerspruch gegen diesen Bescheid kann innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der Muster BKK erhoben werden.

data.tax_note: Sick pay (Krankengeld) you receive is tax-free but subject to the progression clause (Progressionsvorbehalt) and must be declared in your income tax return.
